resolution_notes: Disputed free_tier_limits and rate_limits: Verifier B correctly found published quotas but used wrong numbers/limit types. Official wordsapi.com pricing and RapidAPI public plans (BASIC/PRO/ULTRA/MEGA) show Basic free 2,500/day, Pro 25,000/day, Ultra 250,000/day, Mega 500,000/day—all soft daily quotas with overages (not hard free, not 50k/1M). Docs do not define separate per-second rate caps for public plans. Other fields kept.
free_tier_limits: 2,500 requests/day on RapidAPI BASIC free plan (soft limit; overage $0.004/request)
rate_limits: BASIC free: 2,500/day soft (+$0.004 overage); Pro: 25,000/day soft; Ultra: 250,000/day soft; Mega: 500,000/day soft (RapidAPI daily quotas)
